item.title: Orthodox Jewish women in Israel may now take a rabbinic exam, like men
item.description: Until now, only Orthodox Jewish men in Israel have been allowed to take exams to become rabbis. After a long campaign, women can now also take the test - but still can't become rabbis

item.title: US and Iranian Negotiators Close in on Preliminary Peace Deal
item.description: After several days of renewed strikes on both sides, the United States and Iran are closing in on a preliminary agreement that extends the ceasefire for 60 days, begins negotiations on Iran’s nuclear program and opens the Strait of Hormuz. NBC’s Richard Engel reports for TODAY.

item.title: Asia defense summit opens amid doubts over U.S. priorities
item.description: The Shangri-La Dialogue, hosted by the International Institute for Strategic Studies, will also address tensions in the Middle East and Russia's war on Ukraine.

item.title: Israel, Lebanon officials to meet. And, judge won't block Trump's mail-in voting order
item.description: Israel and Lebanon officials are set to meet today as U.S.-Iran peace talks continue. And, a federal judge declined to block Trump's executive order restricting mail-in voting.

item.title: Australian woman charged over travel to Syria to join Islamic State
item.description: The arrest came eight months after she returned to Australia with her children from Lebanon.

item.title: Why U.S. allies pushed back on Trump’s bid to make Iran deal a package with Israeli normalization
item.description: It was the kind of sweeping, last-minute demand that would have torpedoed most diplomatic talks: President Donald Trump insisting this week that in exchange for him ending the war with Iran, several Arab and Muslim countries should sign on to his Abraham Accords to normalize their diplomatic relations with Israel.

item.title: The possible return of Somali pirates poses a new problem for the shipping industry
item.description: As the global economy focuses on the Strait of Hormuz crisis, another shipping crisis looms in the region — the return of Somali pirates.

item.title: Blue Origin's New Glenn rocket explodes during engine-firing test in Florida
item.description: Jeff Bezos’ Blue Origin New Glenn rocket exploded during an engine-firing test in Florida, which shook nearby homes in Cape Canaveral and Cocoa Beach. In a brief statement, Blue Origin said it "experienced an anomaly" during the test and “will provide updates” as more is learned.

item.title: Extended Interview: Tom Llamas sits down with Secretary of State Marco Rubio
item.description: On the sidelines of the Trump-Xi Summit in Beijing, NBC News' Tom Llamas sits down with Secretary of State Marco Rubio to discuss China policy, the war with Iran, the future of Cuba, and more.

item.title: U.S. strikes Iran again. And, DOJ charges Google staffer over Polymarket trades
item.description: The U.S. says it has struck Iran again as peace talks continue to end the conflict. And, the federal government has charged a Google staffer for allegedly using insider information in Polymarket trades.
